日期：2026-02-01T08:00:00Z
主题：Travel Advance Settlement Policy
Settlement rules:

1. If expenses > advance: company owes the employee the difference (reimbursement)
2. If advance > expenses: employee owes back the difference (repayment required within 14 days)
3. Advances not settled within 30 days of trip end: deduct from next paycheck
4. Include a line-item breakdown of expenses vs advance in the settlement notice
5. Employees with incomplete expense reports (missing receipts noted): put on hold

- Controller"}
